tools.name: part_catalog_lookup
tools.description:
Part Catalog Lookup

Look up part information from the catalog using a triage product ID and a user question.

Args:
    payload: The request body containing triage_product_id and question.
    tenant_id: [TEMPORARY] The tenant ID. This should be removed in the future.
    db_session: Mock database session (ready for future replacement with real DB)

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "Status",
  "message": "Message",
  "parts": [
    {
      "part_id": "Part Id",
      "part_name": "Part Name",
      "part_description": "Part Description",
      "part_image_link": "Part Image Link",
      "part_url_link": "Part Url Link"
    }
  ]
}
```
